-- dim_date: one row per calendar date, generated by Snowflake (no source table needed).

with dates as (

    -- Generate 365 consecutive days starting on 2026-01-01
    select
        dateadd(day, seq4(), '2026-01-01'::date) as date_key
    from table(generator(rowcount => 365))

)

select
    date_key,
    year(date_key)                          as year,
    month(date_key)                         as month,
    day(date_key)                           as day,
    dayname(date_key)                       as weekday_name,   -- 'Mon', 'Tue', ...
    dayofweekiso(date_key) in (6, 7)        as is_weekend      -- 6 = Saturday, 7 = Sunday
from dates

-- Select and rename columns, standardize codes, remove airlines without a name
SELECT DISTINCT
    
    UPPER(TRIM(IATA))
 AS iata_code,
    
    UPPER(TRIM(ICAO))
 AS icao_code,
    TRIM(AIRLINE) AS airline_name,
    TRIM(CALL_SIGN) AS call_sign,
    TRIM(COUNTRY) AS country,
    TRIM(COMMENTS) AS comments
FROM FLIGHT_DB.STAGING.airlines
WHERE
    AIRLINE IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(AIRLINE) != ''

-- Select and rename columns and standardize codes
SELECT DISTINCT
    TRIM(CITY_SERVED) AS city,
    
    UPPER(TRIM(ICAO))
 AS icao_code,
    TRIM(AIRPORT_NAME) AS airport_name,
    
    UPPER(TRIM(IATA))
 AS iata_code,
    TRIM(USAGE) AS airport_usage,
    RUNWAYS AS runways,
    PASSENGERS_2023 AS passengers_2023
FROM FLIGHT_DB.STAGING.airports

-- Välja och döpa om kolumner, kombinerat ankomst- och avgångstider och ta bort identiska rader i resultatet

SELECT DISTINCT
    FLIGHT_ID AS flight_id,
    AIRPORT AS airport,
    DIRECTION AS direction,
    FLIGHT_DATE AS flight_date,
    FLIGHT_LEG_IDENTIFIER__CALLSIGN AS callsign,
    FLIGHT_LEG_IDENTIFIER__DEPARTURE_AIRPORT_IATA AS departure_airport,
    FLIGHT_LEG_IDENTIFIER__ARRIVAL_AIRPORT_IATA AS arrival_airport,
    
    UPPER(TRIM(AIRLINE_OPERATOR__IATA))
 AS airline_iata,
    
    UPPER(TRIM(AIRLINE_OPERATOR__ICAO))
 AS airline_icao,
    TRIM(AIRLINE_OPERATOR__NAME) AS airline_name,
    LOCATION_AND_STATUS__FLIGHT_LEG_STATUS_ENGLISH AS flight_status,

    COALESCE(
        ARRIVAL_TIME__SCHEDULED_UTC,
        DEPARTURE_TIME__SCHEDULED_UTC
    ) AS scheduled_utc,

    COALESCE(
        ARRIVAL_TIME__ESTIMATED_UTC,
        DEPARTURE_TIME__ESTIMATED_UTC
    ) AS estimated_utc,

    COALESCE(
        ARRIVAL_TIME__ACTUAL_UTC,
        DEPARTURE_TIME__ACTUAL_UTC
    ) AS actual_utc

FROM FLIGHT_DB.STAGING.flights

-- One row per airport, identified by IATA code
SELECT
    iata_code AS airport_key,
    iata_code,
    icao_code,
    airport_name,
    city,
    airport_usage,
    runways,
    passengers_2023
FROM FLIGHT_DB.ANALYTICS_stg.stg_airports
WHERE iata_code IS NOT NULL
  AND iata_code != ''
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY iata_code
    ORDER BY airport_name
) = 1

-- One row per airline that operates flights in our data
WITH flight_airlines AS (
    -- Airlines as reported by Swedavia
    SELECT DISTINCT
        airline_iata,
        airline_icao,
        airline_name
    FROM FLIGHT_DB.ANALYTICS_stg.stg_flights
    WHERE airline_iata IS NOT NULL
      AND airline_iata != ''
),

one_per_iata AS (
    -- Guarantee a unique key: keep one row per IATA code
    SELECT *
    FROM flight_airlines
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY airline_iata
        ORDER BY airline_name
    ) = 1
),

wiki_airlines AS (
    -- Wikipedia data, deduplicated on ICAO code
    SELECT
        icao_code,
        call_sign,
        country
    FROM FLIGHT_DB.ANALYTICS_stg.stg_airlines
    WHERE icao_code IS NOT NULL
      AND icao_code != ''
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY icao_code
        ORDER BY airline_name
    ) = 1
)

SELECT
    f.airline_iata AS airline_key,
    f.airline_iata,
    f.airline_icao,
    f.airline_name,
    w.call_sign,
    w.country
FROM one_per_iata AS f
LEFT JOIN wiki_airlines AS w
    ON f.airline_icao = w.icao_code

-- One row per flight, airport, direction and date, with delay measures
WITH flights AS (
    SELECT
        MD5(CONCAT_WS('|', flight_id, airport, direction, flight_date)) AS flight_key,
        flight_id,
        airport AS airport_key,
        airline_iata AS airline_key,
        direction,
        TRY_TO_DATE(flight_date) AS flight_date,
        callsign,
        departure_airport,
        arrival_airport,
        flight_status,
        -- Group statuses such as 'Landed 17:01' or 'Estimated 12:55' into a few categories
        CASE
            WHEN flight_status LIKE 'Landed%' THEN 'Landed'
            WHEN flight_status LIKE 'Estimated%' THEN 'Estimated'
            WHEN flight_status LIKE 'Delayed%' THEN 'Delayed'
            ELSE flight_status
        END AS status_group,
        scheduled_utc,
        estimated_utc,
        actual_utc,
        -- Delay in minutes: actual time minus scheduled time
        ROUND(DATEDIFF('second', scheduled_utc, actual_utc) / 60, 1) AS delay_minutes
    FROM FLIGHT_DB.ANALYTICS_stg.stg_flights
)

SELECT
    *,
    -- Cancelled: the flight was cancelled
    (status_group = 'Cancelled') AS is_cancelled,
    -- Deleted: removed from the schedule, never flown, excluded from statistics
    (status_group = 'Deleted') AS is_deleted,
    -- Only flights with an actual time can be judged on punctuality
    (actual_utc IS NOT NULL) AS has_actual_time,
    -- Delayed means more than 15 minutes late
    COALESCE(delay_minutes > 15, FALSE) AS is_delayed
FROM flights
